headline: UBS BB Lowers Target Price for Itaú Unibanco Despite Solid Q3 Results
summary: UBS BB reduced its target price for Itaú Unibanco while maintaining a Neutral rating, citing macroeconomic headwinds in Brazil despite the bank producing solid third-quarter financial results.
why: Itaú Unibanco is Latin America's largest private financial institution by assets.

impacts.name: Itaú Unibanco
impacts.why: Broader macroeconomic tightening led analysts to trim target equity valuations.
